df = pd.read_csv('.work/out/demo_metadata.csv')
img = cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W = img.shape[:2]
acc = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8)

for i,r in df.iterrows():
    x = ast.literal_eval(r['coords_x']); y = ast.literal_eval(r['coords_y'])
    pts = np.array(list(zip(x,y)), np.int32)
    m = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m, [pts], 1)
    ov = int((m & acc).sum())
    n,_,st,_ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
    area = int(m.sum())
    # iou with original
    r0 = df.iloc[i]
    ox = ast.literal_eval(r0['coords_x']); oy = ast.literal_eval(r0['coords_y'])
    mo = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(mo, [np.array(list(zip(ox,oy)),np.int32)], 1)
